integrity: The displayed equations, incidences, exact matrix rank, and numerical criterion were independently reconstructed for this package. No independent external audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The construction settles existence in degree eight only; it does not classify all degree-eight examples or address degree nine.
Originality is supported by targeted literature comparison and source inspection, not by a theorem of uniqueness in the literature.
The lower bound excluding Jacobian syzygies of degree below four is cited from the published general bound rather than independently reproved.
title: A degree-eight nearly free conic-line arrangement over a quadratic field
